proved_inference: For every physical cross block M with Z=e3(M^T M)>0 and every L>0, either there is a probability law on nonzero 3x3 physical minors with every row load at most 1/2 and KL cost at most L, yielding ||p_Q||_infinity <= 6 sqrt(e) exp(L/6) Z^(-1/6), or at most six physical rows can be deleted so the surviving e3 is less than exp(-L)Z. If no row-capped minor law exists, five rows suffice and surviving e3 is zero. At L=log64 the paid prefactor is 12 sqrt(e), while the hub branch leaves less than Z/64 residual three-volume.
proof_mechanisms: exact identity K(mu)=Z exp(-D(mu||w)) for the natural determinant-squared minor law
fractional matching / fractional vertex-cover LP duality for infeasible row cap
finite-alphabet entropy-projection convex dual for feasible but high-KL row cap
threshold H={i:lambda_i>=sum(lambda)/6} producing at most six hubs
